name: Purchase Order Extractor Workflow – Generate EDI 850

parameters.content:
## 🧾 Generate: EDI 850 (sub-workflow)
Takes one canonical purchase-order object and returns a valid **X12 004010 EDI 850** file. The main workflow calls it through its Execute Workflow node, once per PO, whenever the user opts into EDI export.

## 🔧 Setup
Set your trading-partner values at the top of the **Build 850 String** node: **SENDER_ID**, **RECEIVER_ID**, their qualifiers, and the usage indicator (`T` for test, `P` for production). Free-text units are mapped to X12 **355** codes there, with anything unknown falling back to `EA`.

## ▶️ Receive PO Object
Entry point when the main workflow calls this sub-workflow. Accepts the canonical object (**header** plus **lines**); keep every input field typed **Any** to avoid `fields.join` validator errors.

## 🏗️ Build the 850
Assembles the full X12 envelope, from **ISA/GS/ST** down to **SE/GE/IEA**, out of the PO object. Maps units to X12 **355** codes, keeps the segment and hash totals in sync, and returns the EDI text plus a filename.

## 📄 To .edi File
Writes the EDI text into a downloadable `.edi` binary named after the PO number. This file is what the main workflow receives back and stores in Drive.
